violation_type.title: Parental Notification of Communicable Disease (26 TAC §747.305(d))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation failed to report a communicable disease to Child Care Regulation.

finding_variants.text: The operation failed to report a communicable disease to Child Care Regulation.

Based on investigation findings, proper parental notification was not maintained when the notification to inform parents of a communicable disease failed to reach parents when the designated app for communication was having technical difficulties.
